name: ai-meeting-notes
description: Mac companion for online and in-person audio capture, local Whisper transcription, structured Codex notes, and automatic publication of recordings, full transcripts, and notes to your Meetings page in Codex Spaces. Requires macOS 15+, local dependencies, signed-in Codex CLI, and Pages. Build the companion from source. Recording is explicit, visible, and independently stoppable; online detection asks before recording. This local MCP edition is distributed through the repository marketplace, not the public ChatGPT directory.
